summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a May 11, 2026 press release titled 'Nova Winter Freight Season Complete' regarding completion of its 2026 winter freight mobilization to the Estelle Project in Alaska. The release describes delivery of heavy equipment and supplies for antimony ore processing under a Department of War award, with approximately 1.5 million pounds of freight delivered. No special-situation corporate event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update.
